data.name: Private Boat Charter in Waikiki "Big Kahuna"
data.headline: All Ages • BYOB • 1-4 Hours • Up to 45 people
data.description: Fully customizable private boat charter in Waikiki. Perfect for large group activities such as snorkeling, whale watching, sunset cruises, and watching the Waikiki fireworks offshore. Great platform to host events such as corporate outings, wedding parties, birthdays, memorial services, and much more. Our crew is passionate about the ocean and sharing the spirit of aloha with our island hospitality.

data.booking_notes:
###What's Included:
- Snorkel Gear and flotation vest
- In-water snorkel guide
- Bluetooth sound system
- Marine restroom
- Ice down coolers with water and soft drinks
- Shaded and sunny seating options
- "Lilly Pad" floating lounge mat


###What to Bring:
- Towels
- Bathing suit (Please come dressed to go in the water)
- Sunscreen, Sunshirt, Glasses, Hat, Camera (Optional)
- Prescription Snorkel Mask (Can be rented from Snorkel Bob's if needed)
- Additional drinks or light snacks (Alcohol allowed to be enjoyed after swimming)
- Cash for merch and Gratuity

###Recommendations:
- Facial Hair may affect the mask seal on your face, letting water leak in. Shaving or rubbing petroleum jelly into your mustache can help with this.
- Tying up longer hair to a ponytail at ear level helps the mask sit nicely on your head.
- Freshly applied sunscreen can run down into your eyes, hurting them.
- Motion sickness remedies work better when taken in advance, not when feeling symptoms (Please consult your doctor or physician for advice)
data.check_in_details:
Check in Details:
Please arrive early to Kewalo Basin Harbor Pier A, at least 15 min prior if getting dropped off or 30 min prior if parking. This leaves time for traffic delays, limited parking, and navigating the harbor. Our crew will meet you at the Pier A gate and board your group 10-15 minutes before departure.
* Harbor address refers to the whole harbor, so please type "Hawaii Ocean Charters" into Google or Apple maps for the correct area and look for Pier A
* Paid Parking available ~$2/hr but can be limited on very busy days
[View Kewalo Harbor Parking Map (1).pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/0nOuSu4TjCCXjYbHR1aI)
data.restrictions:
- Basic swimming ability is required to participate in the in-water portion of this charter.
- Snorkeling is a physically strenuous activity, and participants should be in good physical health to participate.
- Boating activities may not be suitable for those with pre-existing health conditions, neck or back problems, or pregnant women.
data.disclaimers: Weather and ocean conditions are outside of our control. While the partially protected south shore of Oahu is a wonderful place to operate, we are still in the open ocean. Passing light rain showers is normal weather in Hawaii. We will not operate in dangerous conditions.
